process_type: Atomic layer epitaxy (ALE) with hydrogen radical-enhanced chemical vapor deposition (HRCVD)
summary: The study investigates the carrier transport properties of iodine-doped (ZnS)3(ZnSe)42 ordered alloys grown by atomic layer epitaxy (ALE) using hydrogen radical-enhanced chemical vapor deposition (HRCVD). The high Hall mobility of 470 cm²/V·s at room temperature is achieved in slightly I-doped samples, attributed to the elimination of structural fluctuations by forming a two-dimensional ordered structure. The results indicate that the layer-by-layer growth and low-temperature process minimize defects and enhance crystal quality.
